title: Bad performance
body: Google keep is one of the most amazing apps if you are using android phones; however, in the iphone is the worst experience. I have it in my Galaxy S20 ultra and it never stop working or shut down suddenly. On the other hand, in my iphone it takes forever to open and hangs when using, it is just the worst.
author: Esam alnaib
